entities.name: PMID:25100676
observations: In a Phaseolus vulgaris experiment, below-ground conspecific neighbor presence altered within-plant seed-size distribution; neighbor plants produced proportionally more large and fewer small seeds.

entities.name: Neighbor shifts seed size
observations: Conspecific below-ground neighbor exposure significantly increased minimum and mean seed size, skewness, and Lorenz asymmetry coefficient in Phaseolus vulgaris; effects persisted after adjustment for resources invested in seed production.
